purpose: Imágenes fotográficas ilustrativas de las cuatro preparaciones del recetario de FEXPO IGA 2026. No son fotografías de platos servidos en el evento.

prompts.arancini: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape food photography for a culinary school fair recipe website. Primary request: close editorial photograph of miniature spherical Sicilian arancini filled with beef tomato ragù, cooked ham cubes, green peas and mozzarella, matching a fair tasting menu. Six golden crisp breadcrumb-coated rice balls, bite-sized about 3 cm, one cleanly cut in half showing yellow turmeric arborio rice, little beef ragù, ham, green peas and white melted mozzarella. Simple off-white ceramic plate on a warm neutral tabletop. Soft natural side light, appetizing genuine crispy texture. Shot at a 45 degree angle, shallow but sufficient depth of field, centered food, landscape 3:2 framing. No people, hands, logos, text, utensils crossing the food, or watermark.
prompts.focaccia: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape editorial food photography for a culinary school fair recipe website. Primary request: four small rectangular bites of baked focaccia sandwich filled with cooked ham, thick tomato sauce and melted mozzarella. The top and bottom are separate layers of airy olive-oil focaccia, golden dimpled crust with rosemary and coarse salt. The visible cross section shows pink cooked ham, red tomato sauce and melted white mozzarella, gratinated and cut into little 4 by 3 cm rectangular tasting portions. This is a focaccia sandwich with a bread lid, not pizza or open toast. Place on an off-white ceramic plate on a warm neutral tabletop. Soft natural side lighting, beautifully realistic bread texture. 45 degree close editorial food photography, centered food, landscape 3:2 framing. No people, text, hands, logos or watermark.
prompts.cannoli: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape editorial food photography for a culinary school fair recipe website. Primary request: a plate of five miniature Italian cannoli filled with orange pastry cream, matching the actual fair recipe. Thin golden fried pastry tubes about 6 cm long, crisp delicate blistered shells, both ends filled with smooth glossy pale golden-orange custard cream (crema pasticcera with orange juice, milk, egg yolks and vanilla). Light dusting of powdered sugar, small orange zest curls on the ends, a small orange wedge alongside as a visual flavor cue. The filling is smooth custard, not ricotta, no chocolate chips or pistachios. Off-white ceramic plate on warm neutral tabletop. Soft daylight, 45 degree angle, centered food, appetizing realistic textures, landscape 3:2 framing. No text, people, hands, logos or watermark.
prompts.menta: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape editorial beverage photograph for a culinary school fair recipe website. Primary request: homemade mint soda made from a real fresh-mint infused sugar syrup and chilled carbonated water, served in a simple clear small tumbler approximately 180 ml, bright tiny carbonation bubbles visible through very pale translucent straw-green liquid, small clean mint sprig garnish and a few fresh mint leaves beside the glass. The syrup comes from real mint leaves, so avoid artificial neon green. No lime or lemon, no alcohol, no straws. On a warm neutral tabletop, soft daylight, subtle condensation, centered glass fully visible, landscape 3:2 framing. A refreshing photorealistic editorial food photograph. No text, hands, people, logos or watermark.
